title: Weekly Care Summary
description:
Weekly care summary for the {family_name} family. Sent Sunday morning.

1. Read families/{family_id}/family.md — load Current + relevant Reference sections
2. Review conversations/{all_member_phones}/ from the past 7 days
3. Compile weekly summary:
   - Medication adherence: how many doses confirmed vs missed
   - Appointments: what happened, any follow-ups needed
   - Wellness trends: sleep, meals, mood patterns
   - Incidents: any falls, emergencies, or concerns
   - Care team notes: any handoff issues, team changes
4. Message primary caregiver with summary
5. If concerning trends: suggest action (e.g., 'Medication was missed 3 times this week — want to adjust the reminder schedule?')
6. Ask: 'Any changes needed for next week?'
7. If family requests changes: route to care-plan-updates protocol
